key_idea: Check every shape against all 3 pictures.
steps: There are 3 pictures. Look for each shape in every one of them.
The blue square, the green triangle, the red circle and the blue circle are in all 3 pictures.
The red rectangle is in the first and the last picture, but not in the middle one.

choice_feedback.A: The blue square is in all 3 pictures.
choice_feedback.C: The green triangle is in all 3 pictures.
choice_feedback.D: There is a red circle in all 3 pictures.
choice_feedback.E: There is a blue circle in all 3 pictures.
